name: Liza 'N' Eliaz
description: '''Liza Néliaz''' (26 February 1958 – 19 February 2001),  known by her stage name '''Liza 'N' Eliaz''', was a Belgian [[Hardcore (electronic dance music genre)|hardcore techno]] producer and disc jockey. Described as a "spiritual leader" in the [[free party]] movement in France, she was a DJ noted for her skill and use of four turntables.
